scope: Prespecified synthetic diagnostic coverage stage, not clinical qualification
rng: NumPy PCG64; independent SeedSequence streams per cell/cohort for parameters, library factors, batch effects, selected hypothesis, counts
batch: 0,1 repeated; balanced within each time; distinct declared units
effects: g000..015 null;4 positive linear,4 negative linear,4 endpoint-neutral nonconstant,4 nonlinear with positive endpoint change; all curves exactly in the fixed3-df centered natural-cubic basis; log4 endpoint/range scaling
primary_coverage: One hypothesis sampled uniformly per cohort by an independent prespecified RNG stream; exact binomial coverage interval over independent cohorts
warning: One-sided Clopper-Pearson upper coverage bound below0.95, Bonferroni0.05 over2 cells; no warning is not acceptance; unassessable if any primary hypothesis unavailable
secondary: All-gene and shape-specific cohort-average coverage, bias and RMSE are descriptive; genes are not independent simulation replicates
failure_policy: Never redraw, retry, replace missing results, change confidence/genes/estimator or tune after freeze; preserve failures and missingness bounds
